# dsh-sidebar-settings-button
DSH plugin: puts a **Settings** row in the sidebar header, immediately **before Plugins**, opening t
he native Settings panel in one click.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What it does
Registers one entry in the sidebar's own `sidebar.panellist` seat with `order: -10` (Plugins ships a
t `0`, Schedules at `10`), so the row lands first and the shipped sidebar draws it: native geometry,
hover, focus ring, collapsed-rail icon and tooltip, localized label. A click opens the same panel a
collapsed-rail icon and tooltip, localized label. A click opens the same panel as `Ctrl+,` / `⌘+,`.
## How it works
**The click is intercepted.** `sidebar.panellist` is the seat for *main panels* — ui-sidebar turns e
ach entry into a button whose `onClick` calls `ctx.layout.selectPanel(id)`, and that id must address
a component in the layout's keyed `main` slot. Settings is not a panel but a modal owned by ui-sett
ings-general, and `selectPanel` throws for an unknown key. So one capture-phase listener on `documen
t` takes the click above the React root (React 18 delegates to the container) and opens Settings ins
tead. It re-resolves the row's enclosing `button` on every click, so the icon, the label and the but
ton's padding all count as the row.
**Settings is opened through the shortcut registry.** `settings.open` is the only programmatic door:
the panel's open state is private to ui-settings-general, and the `settings.launcher` seat that rec
eives `openSettings` is a `single` slot already occupied by the account menu. `ctx.shortcuts.registr
y.invoke(id, context)` is the path the native Electron menu uses to run a command without its key bi
nding. It is called with `modal: null` on purpose — the registry's modal guard would otherwise swall
ow the call whenever any `[role="menu"]` is mounted, and the action is idempotent (`open: true`) so
the panel cannot be toggled shut by accident.
**No silent failures.** Every degraded path returns a short reason, shown in a Toast and logged to t
he console. DevTools is available on **F12**.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh plugin add` is `pnpm add` inside the profile plus a `dsh.profile.bundles` reconcile, so a packa
ge declaring `dsh.bundle` joins the layer list automatically. A folder install is a `link:`, which i
s why this checkout stays the single source of truth.

## Limits
- The **avatar menu's "Settings" item stays** — it belongs to another plugin's React tree. The heade

r row is an additional, always-visible entry point.
- The row's `id` addresses **no main panel**; th
e click interception is the only thing keeping `selectPanel` from throwing. If ui-sidebar ever switc

hes to `onClickCapture`, that interception needs rework (the test only covers our side).
- The sideb
ar passes `{ size, active }`; only `size` is used, and the row is never highlighted — Settings is no
`{ size, active }`; only `size` is used, and the row is never highlighted — Settings is not a panel.
## Layout
No build step: the browser half is a plain classic script calling `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id
, factory })`. Its only `require`s are platform modules (`react`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primit
ives`), so `dsh.client.inject` / `dsh.client.external` are unnecessary.
